CustomObject.description: Maps Salesforce's native Data Classification "Compliance Categorization" (FieldDefinition.ComplianceGroup) to a specific PII field type. Used by AIPiiFieldTypeClassifier as a fallback when no keyword rule matches a field's name or label, so a field an admin has already tagged in Setup's Data Classification is recognized without needing a matching keyword.
CustomObject.label: AI PII Compliance Group Mapping
